text: # glm52-c1-p90-sa: the pinned GLM-5.2-MXFP4 weights and the 062126 AgentX corpus into one HF hub on the node's NVMe
# (refs/main written = the pins, for offline loads). Run on the GPU node through ctrl/. Idempotent.
#   1. model: COPIED from the shared read-only cache /mnt/hf_cache (no HF download; that cache holds snapshot 386bd0e4ec,
#      282 shards). Every file is checked by size, and every LFS file by sha256 against its blob name. If /mnt/hf_cache
#      is not mounted on this node, falls back to snapshot_download at the pinned revision.
#   2. corpus: snapshot_download of the public dataset (InferenceX pins no revision; the one used is recorded).
# No token ever goes into a container.
log "model: copied in $(( $(date +%s) - T )) s; verifying"
# verify: same file set and sizes; LFS files (blob name = 64 hex) by sha256
log "model: $(ls "$DST" | wc -l) files verified (sizes; sha256 of LFS files) in $(( $(date +%s) - T )) s total"
log "model: $SRC not found on this node; falling back to snapshot_download at $MODEL_REV"
have = [f for f in os.listdir(p) if f.endswith(".safetensors") and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(p, f))]
assert len(want) == n, f"index names {len(want)} shards, expected {n}"
print(f"[dl] model index: {len(want)} shards, all present")
n = sum(len(f) for _, _, f in os.walk(p))
# Smoke and before/after measurements for glm52-c1-p90-sa: the full AgentX replay at C1 and GSM8K, before and after
# the campaign. Two fresh servers, each served as Arbor builds the launch (arbor/frameworks/sglang.py:
# python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path M --served-model-name M --host 0.0.0.0 --port P <server_flags>, with the
# config's server_env and ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpus>, no HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES: arbor/frameworks/base.py):
#   A. the measured launch (synthetic MTP acceptance, as CI's perf run) -> the pack's bench_agentx.sh (AgentX, DURATION s)
#   B. the same launch WITHOUT the SGLANG_SIMULATE_* env (real acceptance, as CI's EVAL_ONLY path) -> GSM8K
#      (sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k). With synthetic acceptance the served tokens are not the model's own.
# Each server is stopped by its own process group (SIGTERM; SGLang must exit cleanly to free GPU memory).
# usage: bash ab.sh <tag> <duration_s> <gsm8k_questions>      e.g.  before 3600 1319 | after 3600 1319 | smoke 900 200
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 3 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" && die "a server already answers on port $PORT"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format='tree %H %s'; git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | head -20" > "$OUT_H/tree.txt"
cfg, outh, gpus, port, dur, outc = sys.argv[1:7]
env = {k: v for k, v in c["server_env"].items() if k not in drop}
for k, v in env.items(): f.write(f"export {k}={shlex.quote(v)}\n")
log "$TAG: tree $(head -1 "$OUT_H/tree.txt" | cut -c1-80); GPUs $GPUS port $PORT; AgentX ${DUR}s (synthetic acceptance); GSM8K $NQ (real acceptance)"
gpus_clean() {   # every GPU of $GPUS at <= 10 % VRAM (the CI recipe's own wait, 15 min max)
m=$(docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "rocm-smi -d ${GPUS//,/ } --showmemuse 2>/dev/null" | grep -oE 'VRAM%\): [0-9]+' | awk '{if ($NF > m) m = $NF} END {print m+0}')
log "$TAG: WARNING GPUs $GPUS still at ${m}% VRAM after 15 min"; return 1
gpus_clean || die "GPUs not clean before the $1 server"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" pgrep -f "sglang.launch_server .*--port $PORT " >/dev/null || { log "$TAG: FATAL $1 server died"; tail -30 "$OUT_H/server_$1.log"; exit 1; }
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 5 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" || { log "$TAG: FATAL $1 server not healthy after 40 min"; tail -20 "$OUT_H/server_$1.log"; exit 1; }
log "$TAG: $1 server healthy after $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )) s"
stop_server() {   # SIGTERM to the server's own process group; SIGKILL only to leftovers of OUR mask after 3 min
for i in \$(seq 1 36); do pgrep -f 'sglang.launch_server .*--port $PORT ' >/dev/null || break; sleep 5; done; \
for p in \$(pgrep -f 'sglang'); do grep -qa 'ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPUS' /proc/\$p/environ 2>/dev/null && kill -9 \$p; done; true"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c ". $OUT_C/server_perf.env; export PORT=$PORT MODEL_PATH=$MODEL_ID MODEL_NAME=$MODEL_ID CONCURRENCY=1 NUM_PROMPTS=320 \
log "$TAG: AgentX rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T1 )) s: $(grep -a '^\[bench_agentx\] p90_intvty' "$OUT_H/bench.log" | tail -1)"
log "$TAG: $(grep -a 'cache flushed before the replay' "$OUT_H/bench.log" | tail -1)"
# the bench reads the corpus from the Hub (as CI): record the revision the hub holds after the run
log "$TAG: corpus refs/main $(cut -c1-10 "$HUB_NL/$CORPUS_DIR/refs/main"); snapshots $(ls "$HUB_NL/$CORPUS_DIR/snapshots" | cut -c1-10 | tr '\n' ' ')"
except Exception as e: sys.exit(f"[ab] no bench_output.json: {e}")
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd /tmp && timeout 10800 python3 -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions $NQ --port $PORT --parallel 64" > "$OUT_H/gsm8k.log" 2>&1
log "$TAG: GSM8K ($NQ, real acceptance) rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T2 )) s: $(grep -aiE 'accuracy|invalid|latency' "$OUT_H/gsm8k.log" | tail -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
# Provision the node for glm52-c1-p90-sa. Idempotent; run on the GPU node through ctrl/ after dl.sh. Steps:
#   1. node checks: docker, GPUs idle, host RAM free (HiCache pins ~1.1 TB), other users' containers listed (never touched)
#   2. the CI image by digest (anonymous pull), tagged, digest verified; its baked-in Config.Env recorded
#   3. Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test from the archive (plain tree + a local git commit) under $RUN (outside $TOP), our pack
#   5. the NVMe HF hub: model at its pin (refs/main, 282 shards resolve) and the corpus (dl.sh)
#   6. the container: the NVMe hub at /hf-hub, InferenceX, Arbor, sessions, the experiment
#   7. stack versions; the SGLang tree (workspace_root) committed as shipped; aiter/flydsl paths into the config
#   8. the aiperf environment for the bench (InferenceX's install_agentic_deps); the corpus warmed into its datasets cache
#   9. ruppell for the profiler skill (not fatal)
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "no working docker daemon"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -v "^$CONTAINER " | sed 's/^/[prepare] other container (not ours, not touched): /'
[ "${vram:-0}" -le 1 ] || [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$CONTAINER" 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die "a GPU is in use before start"
log "host RAM available: ${avail:-?} GB (HiCache ratio 1.5 at TP4 pins ~1.1 TB)"
[ "${avail:-0}" -ge 1500 ] || log "WARNING: less than 1500 GB host RAM available"
*"$IMAGE_DIGEST"*) log "image ok: $IMAGE_TAG = $IMAGE_DIGEST";; *) die "image digest mismatch";; esac
git -C "$ARBOR" init -q && git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh add -A \
&& git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh commit -q -m "AMD-AGI/Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test $ARBOR_SHA (archive)" || die "Arbor git"
# Local fix, as musespark-c1-p90-sa's tree (its commit 3a404ad): the bench prompt's Monitor watch prints a heartbeat;
# the Claude CLI ends a Monitor that is silent for 10 min, and a 3600 s bench is longer (crusoe-arbor-run pitfall).
if ! git -C "$ARBOR" log --format=%s | grep -q '^local fix: the bench prompt.s Monitor watch prints a heartbeat'; then
git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh am -q "$EXP/stage/0001-monitor-heartbeat.patch" || die "heartbeat patch"
grep -q 'do sleep 30; echo waiting; done' "$ARBOR/arbor/policy/claude_loop.py" || die "heartbeat fix missing"
# No CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md may sit above the agents' cwd (the Arbor tree) or their HOME.
log "pack $PACK and config $CONFIG_REL installed; no CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md above the Arbor tree or the agents' HOME"
python3 -m venv "$VENV" && "$PY" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && "$PY" -m pip install -q pyyaml claude-agent-sdk || die "venv"
render=$(getent group render | cut -d: -f3); video=$(getent group video | cut -d: -f3)
# -w /workspace (CI's cwd: pyxis --container-workdir=/workspace/; as glm52-c16-tput): the image's WORKDIR /sgl-workspace
# holds the SGLang checkout, and from there `import sglang` resolves to /sgl-workspace/sglang/ as a namespace package
# (no __file__, no sglang.test), so a `python3 -m sglang.launch_server` started by Arbor (docker exec, no -w) fails.
# The default cwd of `docker exec` (Arbor's server launch has no -w) must import the real SGLang package.

docker exec "$CONTAINER" python3 -c "import sglang, sglang.launch_server; assert sglang.__file__, 'namespace sglang'; print('[prepare] default cwd', __import__('os').getcwd(), '-> sglang', sglang.__version__, sglang.__file__)"     || die "import sglang from the container's default cwd does not give the real package (WORKDIR shadow)"
python3 -c "import sglang, torch; print(\"sglang:\", sglang.__version__, sglang.__file__); print(\"torch:\", torch.__version__, torch.version.hip)"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "$WORKSPACE_ROOT is not a git tree"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.email >/dev/null || { git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.email arbor@local; git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.name Arbor; }"
# Commit the image's tracked-file modifications (if any) as a baseline, so Arbor's diffs start from the code as shipped.
log "image's SGLang tree as shipped has $(echo "$dirty" | wc -l) modified tracked files: $(echo "$dirty" | awk '{print $2}' | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-200) (diff: logs/image_sglang_tree.diff)"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd $WORKSPACE_ROOT && git add -u && git commit -q -m 'baseline: working-tree changes as shipped in $IMAGE_TAG@$IMAGE_DIGEST'" || die "baseline commit"
log "workspace $WORKSPACE_ROOT at $(docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format='%h %s' | cut -c1-90)"
pk = [e for e in cfg.get("editable_packages", []) if e.get("name") not in ("aiter", "flydsl")]
path = r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip() else ""
if [ -x "${AIPERF_CLI:-}" ] && [ -f "$AIPERF_RUNTIME_DIR/.ready" ]; then echo "aiperf present"; exit 0; fi
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c 'test -f /root/inferencex-agentic/.ready' || die "aiperf environment not ready"
# The bench loads the corpus with TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 (huggingface_hub then runs offline): aiperf's `datasets` then
# reads only its own prepared cache (/root/.cache/huggingface/datasets, container-local), not the hub snapshot. Warm it
# with one online load at the pinned corpus revision (CI loads the corpus from the Hub online), then check the offline load.

env -u HF_HUB_OFFLINE -u TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE HF_HUB_CACHE=/hf-hub \$PYA -c 'from datasets import load_dataset; ds = load_dataset(\"$CORPUS_ID\", split=\"train\", revision=\"$(cat "$HUB_NL/$CORPUS_DIR/refs/main")\"); print(\"warm\", len(ds))' 2>&1 | tail -1

env -u HF_HUB_OFFLINE TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_CACHE=/hf-hub \$PYA -c 'from datasets import load_dataset; ds = load_dataset(\"$CORPUS_ID\", split=\"train\"); print(\"OFFLINE_LOAD_OK rows\", len(ds), ds.cache_files[0][\"filename\"])' 2>&1 | tail -1"     | tee "$LOGS/corpus_offline_test.txt" | sed 's/^/[prepare] corpus: /'
grep -q "OFFLINE_LOAD_OK.*$(cat "$HUB_NL/$CORPUS_DIR/refs/main")" "$LOGS/corpus_offline_test.txt" || die "corpus does not load offline at the pinned revision"
[ "$(git -C "$INFX" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$INFX_SHA" ] || die "InferenceX is not at $INFX_SHA"

[ -z "$(git -C "$INFX" status --porcelain)" ] && log "InferenceX still clean at ${INFX_SHA:0:10}" || log "WARNING InferenceX tree changed: $(git -C "$INFX" status --porcelain | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" python3 -c "import sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k" 2>/dev/null && log "GSM8K tool present (sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k)" || log "WARNING sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k not importable"
